```text
Myks renders the Kubernetes manifests of many clusters from one Git repository.

It downloads Helm charts, Git repositories and plain YAML (vendir), renders them
for each environment with Helm and ytt, optionally pins images by digest (kbld),
and writes plain YAML to rendered/, plus Argo CD Applications when enabled.
Commit that output, and every change is a reviewable diff.

Start with:
  myks init      create a sample project
  myks render    download sources and render manifests (Smart Mode: only what changed)
  myks inspect   show environments and applications, and which file sets each value

Documentation: https://mykso.github.io/myks/
Issues:        https://github.com/mykso/myks/issues

Usage:
  myks [command]

Available Commands:
  cleanup      Cleanup obsolete manifests and cache entries
  completion   Generate the autocompletion script for the specified shell
  help         Help about any command
  init         Initialize new myks project
  inspect      Inspect environments, applications, and prototypes
  kbld         Run embedded kbld
  migrate      Convert a legacy ytt data-values repo to the KCL configuration layer
  print-config Print myks configuration
  render       Render application manifests
  vendir       Run embedded vendir
  ytt          Run embedded ytt

Flags:
  -a, --async int                               sets the number of applications to be processed in parallel
                                                the default (0) is no limit
      --buffer-plugin-output                    buffer plugin output instead of streaming (useful for parallel execution)
      --config string                           config file (default is the first .myks.yaml up the directory tree)
  -h, --help                                    help for myks
  -l, --log-level string                        set the logging level (default "info")
      --print-stats                             print tool resource statistics directly to stdout
      --smart-mode.base-revision string         base revision to compare against in Smart Mode
                                                if not provided, only local changes will be considered
      --smart-mode.only-print string[="text"]   only print the list of environments and applications that would be rendered in Smart Mode
                                                accepted values: "text" (default), "json"
                                                legacy boolean values (true, 1, yes) are treated as "text" for backward compatibility
                                                legacy falsey values (false, 0, no) disable Smart Mode only-print (same as leaving it empty)
                                                when used without a value (--smart-mode.only-print), defaults to "text"
  -v, --version                                 version for myks

Use "myks [command] --help" for more information about a command.
```
